tools.description: Classify supplied tickets into billing, access, outage, defect, delivery, or account when one documented keyword list has the most matches. tools.name: customer-support_ticket-prioritize
tools.description: Set priority from a supplied severity and from documented urgency and business-impact phrases. A ticket with none of those signals stays unspecified. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/customer-support/ticket-prioritize. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: customer-support_ticket-deduplicate
tools.description: Find duplicate tickets for the same email address and repeated wording across customers. Each pair names the rule and a confidence level. Tickets are not merged. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/customer-support/ticket-deduplicate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: customer-support_conversation-summarize
tools.description: Restate up to three customer sentences and quote supplied agent replies. The summary does not decide that a ticket was resolved. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/customer-support/conversation-summarize. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: customer-support_sentiment-analyze
tools.description: Label customer wording with a documented positive and negative word list. Text with no listed words stays unspecified. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/customer-support/sentiment-analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.description: Draft a reply that quotes the customer and a supplied policy only when that policy shares a word with the ticket. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "customer-support" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: customer-support_ticket-classify, customer-support_sentiment-analyze, customer-support_quality-audit · Public sink: customer-support_ticket-classify, customer-support_ticket-prioritize, customer-support_ticket-deduplicate, customer-support_conversation-summarize, customer-support_sentiment-analyze, customer-support_resolution-suggest, customer-support_escalation-detect, customer-support_quality-audit · Destructive: customer-support_ticket-classify, customer-support_ticket-prioritize, customer-support_ticket-deduplicate, customer-support_conversation-summarize, customer-support_sentiment-analyze, customer-support_resolution-suggest, customer-support_escalation-detect, customer-support_quality-audit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: customer-support_ticket-classify, customer-support_sentiment-analyze, customer-support_quality-audit · Public sink: customer-support_ticket-classify, customer-support_ticket-prioritize, customer-support_ticket-deduplicate, customer-support_conversation-summarize, customer-support_sentiment-analyze, customer-support_resolution-suggest, customer-support_escalation-detect, customer-support_quality-audit · Destructive: customer-support_ticket-classify, customer-support_ticket-prioritize, customer-support_ticket-deduplicate, customer-support_conversation-summarize, customer-support_sentiment-analyze, customer-support_resolution-suggest, customer-support_escalation-detect, customer-support_quality-audit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
